tasks.subject: Task 1: Install dom-to-image-more dependency
tasks.description:
**Goal:** 安装 dom-to-image-more 替代 html2canvas 作为长图导出引擎

**Files:**
- Modify: `package.json`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dom-to-image-more` 出现在 `package.json` dependencies 中
- [ ] `npm install` 成功

**Verify:** `npm ls dom-to-image-more` → 显示版本号

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json"], "verifyCommand": "npm ls dom-to-image-more", "acceptanceCriteria": ["dom-to-image-more installed successfully"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Override Tailwind colors with hex @theme
tasks.description:
**Goal:** 在 `index.css` 中用 `@theme` 定义完整色板，确保 Tailwind v4 全部输出 #RRGGBB

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/index.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `@theme` 块覆盖 Tailwind 默认所有常用色阶
- [ ] 每个色阶包含完整 11 级
- [ ] 全部使用 #RRGGBB 格式
- [ ] 项目 `npm run build` 正常

**Verify:** `npm run build` → Build success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/index.css"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["@theme block covers all Tailwind color scales with hex values", "project builds successfully"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Create generic exporter.js module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** 新建 `src/utils/exporter.js`，提供 `exportToImage` 和 `exportToPDF` 两个通用导出函数

**Files:**
- Create: `src/utils/exporter.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `exportToImage(elementId, options)` 使用 dom-to-image-more 3x 倍率输出 PNG 长图并触发下载
- [ ] `exportToPDF(elementId, options)` 使用 window.open + window.print 原生渲染输出 PDF
- [ ] `forceHexColorsToInline(root)` 遍历 DOM 树，将 computedStyle 中的颜色强制写为内联 #RRGGBB
- [ ] `toHex(colorString)` 支持 rgb/rgba/oklch → #RRGGBB 转换

**Verify:** `npm run build` → Build success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/utils/exporter.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["exportToImage uses dom-to-image-more 3x PNG", "exportToPDF uses window.print for native rendering", "forceHexColorsToInline converts all colors to hex inline", "toHex handles rgb/rgba/oklch conversion"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Create FloatingScrollButton and CustomScrollbar
tasks.description:
**Goal:** 封装 FloatingScrollButton（一键到底/回顶悬浮按钮）和 CustomScrollbar（自定义快速滚动条）两个独立组件

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/FloatingScrollButton.jsx`
- Create: `src/components/CustomScrollbar.jsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] FloatingScrollButton 右下角显示，到底翻转，点击平滑滚动
- [ ] CustomScrollbar 比例滑块，拖动定位，仅超一屏显示

**Verify:** `npm run build` → Build success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/FloatingScrollButton.jsx", "src/components/CustomScrollbar.jsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["FloatingScrollButton shows at bottom-right when content overflows", "arrow flips direction at bottom", "CustomScrollbar shows track+thumb proportional to viewport/content ratio", "drag-scroll works on touch and mouse"]}
```

- Modify: `src/pages/QuotationPage.jsx`
- Modify: `src/pages/QuotationNewPage.jsx`
- Modify: `src/pages/RecordsPage.jsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Layout 滚动容器添加 id="main-scroll"
- [ ] 三个长列表页面均导入并使用 FloatingScrollButton 和 CustomScrollbar

**Verify:** `npm run build` → Build success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/Layout.jsx", "src/pages/QuotationPage.jsx", "src/pages/QuotationNewPage.jsx", "src/pages/RecordsPage.jsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Layout scroll container has id main-scroll", "QuotationPage integrates both scroll components", "QuotationNewPage integrates both scroll components", "RecordsPage integrates both scroll components"]}
```
